description: A belted, double-breasted tan coat with a diagonal herringbone-like weave hangs on a wooden peg in a dark workshop. Droplets of water bead and run down its surface. Rolled bolts of dark fabric sit on a plank shelf below, with a pair of shears hanging on the wall to the right and a paper pattern pinned to the wall at upper right. The scene is a dim, warm-toned oil painting filling the whole frame edge to edge.
